annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley sobre Regulación y Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill on the Regulation and Use of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Anahí Costa (Senado y Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine congressional bill establishing a general framework for AI use, based on UNESCO-derived principles. It sets prohibitions (including military use and replacing human accountability), creates an executive-designated oversight body, impact assessments/audits, a provider registry, and sanctions. Only passing mention of autonomous vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Nine guiding principles derived from UNESCO Recommendation (proportionality, safety, fairness, human oversight, transparency, accountability).
Article 6 prohibits AI that harms rights, replaces human accountability, or has military/warlike use.
Executive-designated enforcement body to oversee ethics and risk prevention.
Impact assessments or audits at the body's discretion, before or during use.
Registry of AI developers and providers; sanctions from warning to exclusion.
